Focused UI testing with Cathy verified the main click-through symptom is fixed for existing non-primary Robert: selecting Robert then clicking Profile opened /app/participants/seed-robert_kowalski-f0844844, H1 showed Robert's profile, and nav-profile had bg-primary-k text-white. ui_bugs.issue: Direct navigation to /app/participants/seed-robert_kowalski-f0844844 with Dorothy stored active redirects back to Dorothy and renders Mum's profile instead of Robert's profile.

integration_issues.issue: URL participant does not win over persisted active participant; frontend state and rendered profile are inconsistent with the requested /app/participants/:id route.

action_items: Fix ParticipantProfile/ParticipantsContext sync so a directly loaded /app/participants/:id route updates the active participant to the URL id even when localStorage has a different participant, without breaking header-switcher-initiated navigation while already on a profile page.
critical_code_review_comments: ParticipantProfile.jsx currently prioritizes active.id over the URL id in its sync effect. When active is restored as Dorothy, navigating to Robert's route is replaced with Dorothy's route before URL state can win.

rca_of_the_issue: Partial fix: /app/me now respects active participant and sidebar highlighting works. Remaining failure appears caused by the ParticipantProfile sync effect giving persisted active participant precedence over the route param, so direct/bookmarked route ids can be overwritten by localStorage-backed active state. Broad iter-117 tool cascade was not retested because this was a focused bug verification.
